summary: Round 2. All three round-one findings are resolved and each was verified by running, not by reading. (1) task_for is pure: re + dict lookup + string ops, no filesystem/clock/subprocess; plan() is behaviour-identical for ids that resolve and for ids that do not (bogus id still exits 1 with the same 'cannot locate a test source' message). (2) The replacement mechanism wording is TRUE, measured: `./gradlew test --tests binjava.binstore.VersionTest` is BUILD SUCCESSFUL with seven sibling modules reported NO-SOURCE, and `./gradlew :binstore-spi:test --tests binjava.nowhere.NoSuchTest` FAILS with 'No tests found for given includes' -- so skipped-not-failed holds and has-sources-no-match-fails holds; org.gradle.parallel=true at gradle.properties:16 makes the XML-before-abort ordering a genuine race. (3) All four named mutations are killed, plus two I added (drop the leading colon; add 'main' to SOURCE_SET_TASK). The only survivors -- startswith('buildSrc/') -> in, and module -> full path-before-/src/ -- are equivalent over the domain source_of's `*/src/*/java/` glob can produce. tdd-red.sh's `case buildSrc:*` still routes both shapes correctly and is the only consumer of plan output. No object-store request path is touched.
